snippet.title: Pac-Man Arrangement (Arcade) Playthrough (No Death)
snippet.description:
A complete playthrough of Namco's 1996 arcade game, Pac-Man Arrangement.

Final Score: 1.182,660

Pac-Man Arrangement, similar to the original Pac-Man, follows Pac-Man as he tries to eat all the Pac-Dots across 23 rounds (22 rounds and a final boss round)

- Subscribe! https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCNd3Xtm3nSHxbF-J3przS6w?sub_confirmation=1
- Check out my playthroughs!https://www.youtube.com/@matheusbelmont/playlists
